design.factorial_structure: 2 hardware strata x 2 engines x 2 named build endpoints x 3 datasets x 3 randomized blocks
design.unit_of_inference: independent randomized block within hardware stratum
design.reporting_scope: metric-by-hardware-by-engine-by-dataset; no workload or quality pooling

analysis.scope: post-hoc estimation over the complete retained aggregate metric inventory
analysis.paired_interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval across three blocks (df=2)
analysis.hardware_interaction_interval: difference of independent hardware-stratum effects with Welch-Satterthwaite interval
analysis.cross_engine_scope: only exact named endpoint contrasts for semantically comparable client-visible and lifecycle quantities

quality_score.label: Quality score
quality_score.description: Dataset evaluator score on the fixed attempted cohort.

node_seconds_per_request.label: Node seconds per request
node_seconds_per_request.description: Measured benchmark makespan normalized by attempted requests.

request_rate_node_s.label: Request rate
request_rate_node_s.description: Exact reciprocal view of node seconds per request.

mean_ttft_s.formula: server path: sum of reconstructed per-request TTFTs / reconstructed request count, where each request TTFT sums admitted prefill-chunk latencies through its last chunk; fallback: producer client aggregate or sum of successful-request TTFTs / successful-request count
mean_ttft_s.label: Mean time to first token
mean_ttft_s.description: Producer-preferred server aggregation sums every admitted prefill-chunk latency for each request through its last chunk, then averages those reconstructed request TTFTs; a client aggregate or successful-request mean is the fallback. The retained aggregate does not retain the chosen path, denominator count, or constituent request distribution.

decode_step_latency_s.formula: sum of nonnegative latencies from admitted decode, decoding, and mixed server records / count of those latency-bearing records; fallback: producer client aggregate or mean of (request latency - request TTFT) / output-token count across successful positive-output requests
decode_step_latency_s.label: Decode-step latency
decode_step_latency_s.description: Arithmetic mean over latency-bearing decode, decoding, and mixed server records, with a producer client/per-successful-request fallback only when no such record is available. The retained aggregate does not retain the contributing record count or latency distribution.

decode_per_user_rate_tok_s.label: Per-user decode rate
decode_per_user_rate_tok_s.description: Exact reciprocal view of decode-step latency.

delivered_output_tok_s.label: Delivered output rate
delivered_output_tok_s.description: Output tokens delivered per node wall-clock second.

decode_step_output_tok_s.label: Decode-step output rate
decode_step_output_tok_s.description: Node output-token capacity from the ratio of mean decode batch to mean step latency.

physical_prefill_tok_s.formula: prefill_forwarded_tokens / prefill_step_elapsed_s; mixed steps remain included
physical_prefill_tok_s.label: Physical prefill rate
physical_prefill_tok_s.description: Forwarded prefill tokens per measured prefill-step second, including mixed steps.

prefill_pass_latency_s.formula: sum of nonnegative latencies from the producer's admitted client-prefill record set / count of those latency-bearing prefill records
prefill_pass_latency_s.label: Prefill-pass latency
prefill_pass_latency_s.description: Arithmetic mean over latency-bearing records in the producer's client-prefill pass set, after its health-probe and warm-up anchoring rules. The retained aggregate does not retain the contributing pass count or latency distribution.

prefill_mean_batch.formula: sum of nonnegative batch sizes from the producer's admitted client-prefill record set / count of those batch-bearing prefill records
prefill_mean_batch.label: Mean prefill batch
prefill_mean_batch.description: Arithmetic mean of nonnegative batch sizes in the producer's admitted client-prefill record set. The retained aggregate does not retain the contributing pass count or batch-size distribution.

decode_mean_batch.formula: sum of nonnegative batch sizes from admitted decode, decoding, and mixed server records / count of those batch-bearing records
decode_mean_batch.label: Mean decode batch
decode_mean_batch.description: Arithmetic mean of nonnegative batch sizes over admitted decode, decoding, and mixed server records. The retained aggregate does not retain the contributing record count or batch-size distribution.

output_tokens_per_request.formula: sum of per-attempt generated-token counts (successful recorded output length or re-tokenized generated text; failed attempts contribute zero) / attempted request count
output_tokens_per_request.label: Output tokens per request
output_tokens_per_request.description: Attempted-cohort generated-token total divided by attempted requests; failed attempts contribute zero output tokens. The aggregate retains the total and denominator, but not the constituent per-request token distribution.

nominal_prefill_tokens_per_request.formula: sum of per-attempt input-token counts (recorded prompt length, falling back to the tokenized prompt length) / attempted request count
nominal_prefill_tokens_per_request.label: Nominal prefill tokens per request
nominal_prefill_tokens_per_request.description: Attempted-cohort input-token total divided by attempted requests, including requests rejected before generation. The aggregate retains the total and denominator, but not the constituent per-request token distribution.

prefill_forwarded_tokens_per_request.label: Forwarded prefill tokens per request
prefill_forwarded_tokens_per_request.description: Physically forwarded prefill-token work per attempted request.

prefill_step_elapsed_per_request_s.formula: prefill_step_elapsed_s / quality.attempted; mixed steps remain included
prefill_step_elapsed_per_request_s.label: Prefill-step time per request
prefill_step_elapsed_per_request_s.description: Aggregate prefill-step wall time per attempted request, including mixed steps.

forwarded_to_nominal_ratio.label: Forwarded-to-nominal prefill ratio
forwarded_to_nominal_ratio.description: Physical forwarded prefill tokens relative to nominal attempted input tokens.

activated_experts_prefill.formula: arithmetic mean over admitted prefill records of [sum over observed layers of count(expert IDs with thresholded logical_count > 0) / observed layer count]
activated_experts_prefill.label: Distinct experts per layer in admitted prefill records
activated_experts_prefill.description: The recorder thresholds logical expert counts at > 0, counts distinct expert IDs separately per observed layer, averages layer counts within each admitted client-prefill record, then averages over admitted records. The retained aggregate does not retain the contributing admitted-record count, observed-layer counts, or constituent record/layer distributions; the source expert trace was vetted and withheld.

activated_experts_decode.formula: arithmetic mean over admitted decode records of [sum over observed layers of count(expert IDs with thresholded logical_count > 0) / observed layer count]
activated_experts_decode.label: Distinct experts per layer in admitted decode records
activated_experts_decode.description: The recorder thresholds logical expert counts at > 0, counts distinct expert IDs separately per observed layer, averages layer counts within each admitted decode, decoding, or mixed record, then averages over admitted records. The retained aggregate does not retain the contributing admitted-record count, observed-layer counts, or constituent record/layer distributions; the source expert trace was vetted and withheld.

environment_setup_s.label: Environment setup time
environment_setup_s.description: Lifecycle wall time spent preparing the job environment.

server_initialisation_s.label: Server initialisation time
server_initialisation_s.description: Lifecycle wall time from server start through readiness.

client_s.formula: integer-second benchmark-client wall clock including evaluation
client_s.label: Client time
client_s.description: Benchmark-client lifecycle wall time, including evaluation.

job_s.formula: integer-second composite job wall clock before development publication
job_s.label: Job time
job_s.description: Composite measured lifecycle wall time before development publication.

timing_stream.format: four concatenated one-object JSON values in declared order

invariants: quality total/attempted/served/completed are exact cohort identities (256 each), not separate analytical outcomes
performance.request/s is the exact reciprocal alias of performance.e2e_s
decode_per_user_rate_tok_s is the exact reciprocal alias of performance.tpot
prefill and decode token totals equal their per-request fields multiplied by 256
metadata mean prefill/decode batch sizes equal their metrics counterparts
vLLM expert-activation zeros are structural sentinels and map to unavailable observations
SGLang expert-activation observations require positive aggregates and vetted source attestations
all positive analytical values are validated before log transformation

request_level_reanalysis.reason: retained generations and grader outputs are incomplete
request_level_reanalysis.scope: generation-level and judge-log reanalysis beyond retained aggregates

evidence.note: Missing PVC-only artifacts are disclosed and never reconstructed from cohort peers.
